details: 204 byte-for-byte outputs: LE/BE x codec 0/2 x 1/2/6 channels x 8000/44100/96000 Hz, odd frame counts, as copy framecrc (detected and -f epaf), WAV, AIFF (1-2 channels), raw copy and s16le decode
40 framecrc timings: input/output -ss/-t, -t, -frames:a 2, input -ss; copy and volume/asetnsamples chain; 4 LE/BE codec files
17 outputs for 6 unlabelled channels under default, -guess_layout_max 2 and 0 (WAV, W64, AU, copy/decoded framecrc, AIFF when not guessed)
16 exit-code comparisons: codec 1, codec 3, 0 and 513 channels, negative rate, 1000- and 23-byte headers (183), detected and -f epaf; partial trailing frame (native 0, refused)

unsupported: Codec 1 (24-bit) and codecs other than 0 and 2: refused with 183 as natively
Partial trailing sample frames: refused (exit 1) where native decodes with an error and exits 0

AIFF output of a guessed multichannel layout (3+ channels, guessing enabled): native writes a CHAN layout tag, the shared PCM path passes no mask to the AIFF muxer; not refusable from the demuxer and untested beyond 6 channels
Undetected inputs whose probe fails (zero channel word, <24 bytes) exit 1 with 'Unsupported audio container signature' from the shared detector; native exits 183
No mux (native has none); Workers/R2/FLAC paths not exercised

notes: Setup durations: submodule init 42s; npm ci + reference:build 3m03s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+unit 2m18s.
Probe score is 75 natively; the registry probe is exact with precedence 100. Native's .paf/.fap extension match only scores 1, so no demux.extensions are declared.
Truncated headers (<2048 bytes) are INVALIDDATA natively (avio_skip past EOF fails), so they are refused with 183 rather than as unimplemented.

Needed shared edit, not made: packages/avformat/src/index.ts passes stream.channelMask=null for guessed layouts, so the AIFF muxer omits the CHAN chunk native writes; packages/containers/src/aiff.ts also writes a channel bitmap where native's ff_mov_write_chan writes a layout tag (e.g. MPEG_5_1_A for 5.1, also for WAV input).
Unit baseline failures are the expected FLAC (missing edge-flac.wasm / native-cases.json) and resample-checkpoint macOS digest failures; the final set is identical.
